# Assessed-only adapter. A count or baron may read their own case revision,
# but receives no authority to open cases, reserve capacity or assess anyone.
zg361_cp_r_subject_read_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_r_subject_seen_revision value = var:zg361_cp_r_visible_revision }
	}
}

# Subject-scope entry; ROOT remains the eligible direct manager.
zg361_cp_r_launch_effect = {
	zg361_case_r_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
				var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}

		zg361_cp_r_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_r_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_cp_r_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_cp_r_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cp_r_cycle value = var:zg361_case_r_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cp_r_case value = var:zg361_case_r_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_cp_r_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_cp_r_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.131 } }
		}
	}
}
